# remnawave_node_integration (Resource)

Manages a Remnawave 3.3+ node integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "remnawave_node_integration" "environment" {
  name        = "Common node environment"
  description = "Environment values injected into assigned nodes"

  config = jsonencode({
    environmentVariables = {
      XRAY_LOCATION_ASSET = "/usr/local/share/xray"
    }
  })

  # Force-restart nodes using this integration after an update.
  restart_nodes_on_update = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String, Sensitive) Integration configuration as a JSON object. The structure is consumed by Remnawave and the node.
- `name` (String) Integration name (2-30 chars).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional integration description (max 255 chars).
- `restart_nodes_on_update` (Boolean) Force-restart affected nodes after updating the integration. Defaults to false; the preference is retained in Terraform state but is not persisted by Remnawave.

### Read-Only

- `uuid` (String) UUID of the node integration.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a Remnawave 3.3+ node integration by UUID.
terraform import remnawave_node_integration.environment 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
